videos.name: Rough Seas on Royal Caribbean's Vision of the Seas
videos.description:
!!Subscribe for more content like this!!
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCmTwsd2YTjS9xykmScB_SrA?sub_confirmation=1

While we are on a Royal Caribbean cruise on the Vision of the Seas, we ran into a little weather. I should say that the video makes this look worse than it was, I was having a blast during all this and the crew was amazing. Very professional helping keep everyone safe. I just wanted to share a little of the video I captured during the rough waves.

hero.alt: Quantum of the Seas in Juneau, Alaska, with floatplanes on the water
hero.eyebrow: CRUISE DAYS. SHORE STORIES. A LIFE TOGETHER.
heading: More ocean.
More memories.
Always together.
hero.description: Twenty years together, at least ten more cruises since our first, and so many memories still to make.

upcoming.title: Alaska
upcoming.imageAlt: Quantum of the Seas photographed in Juneau, Alaska
upcoming.intro: We’re heading north for a new chapter: seven days cruising Alaska aboard Quantum of the Seas.
notes: Our next cruise departs May 17, 2027. This is where we’ll share the planning, the sailing, and the memories that come home with us.
For now, the ship, departure date, and seven-day duration are set. We’ll add our ports and excursion plans as we get closer to sailing.

destinations.name: Nassau
destinations.sub: Our Bahamas story, beyond the port.
destinations.text: On our first cruise, we headed beyond the port and markets to explore Nassau. One of our favorite sights was the Queen’s Staircase in the Fort Fincastle Historic Complex.
destinations.imageAlt: Nassau from our original cruise journal

destinations.name: Key West
destinations.sub: A little wandering. A lot to come back for.
destinations.text: We loved walking around Key West and seeing the sights. We stopped for lunch at Sloppy Joe’s Bar, and left wanting more time to explore. This is a place we would love to visit again.
destinations.imageAlt: Key West from our original cruise journal

destinations.name: CocoCay
destinations.sub: Clear water. Slow days. Nowhere else to be.
destinations.text: Our favorite stop on the trip was Royal Caribbean’s private island, called Cocoa Cay in our original journal. We spent the day relaxing on a beach bed, snorkeling in clear water, and enjoying lunch delivered to our cabana bed.
destinations.imageAlt: CocoCay from our original cruise journal

destinations.name: Cancún
destinations.text: Cancún brings Mexico’s Caribbean coastline into our travel map, with bright blue water and white-sand shores.
destinations.imageAlt: Representative photograph of Cancún beach and its turquoise water
destinations.photoCaption: Representative view: the beach in Cancún, Mexico.

destinations.name: Cozumel
destinations.text: Our Cozumel films capture an ATV adventure to Jade Caverns, an off-road buggy excursion, and a cooking-and-tasting experience. Explore those moments below.
destinations.imageAlt: Representative photograph of Palancar Beach, Cozumel
destinations.photoCaption: Representative view: Palancar Beach, Cozumel, Mexico.

destinations.name: Jamaica
destinations.sub: Another island on our travel map.
destinations.text: Jamaica is part of our Caribbean travel story, alongside our stops in the Bahamas. An island chapter in a growing collection of places we’ve explored.
destinations.imageAlt: Representative photograph of Doctor’s Cave Beach in Montego Bay, Jamaica
destinations.photoCaption: Representative view: Doctor’s Cave Beach, Montego Bay, Jamaica.

destinations.name: Belize
destinations.text: Belize is one of the Central American destinations we’ve visited. It joins Honduras in the coastal side of our travel collection.
destinations.imageAlt: Representative photograph of Silk Caye, Belize, with palms and clear water

destinations.name: Honduras
destinations.text: Honduras is another place on our Central American travel map, alongside Belize. One more chapter in our collection of sea days and shore stories.
destinations.imageAlt: Representative photograph of a beach on Roatán, Honduras

destinations.name: Ensenada
destinations.sub: A different coast. A Pacific perspective.
destinations.text: Ensenada is part of our Mexico travel collection. Here the setting shifts from Caribbean shores to Baja California’s Pacific waterfront.
destinations.imageAlt: Representative photograph of Ensenada’s waterfront and city skyline
destinations.photoCaption: Representative view: Ensenada waterfront, Baja California, Mexico.

destinations.name: Cabo San Lucas
destinations.sub: Where the rocks meet the open sea.
destinations.text: Cabo San Lucas adds another Baja California chapter to our travels. Its coastal rock formations and blue water give this destination a different look from our Caribbean stops.
destinations.imageAlt: Representative photograph of the Arch at Cabo San Lucas
destinations.photoCaption: Representative view: the Arch at Cabo San Lucas, Baja California Sur, Mexico.

stories.title: Our First Cruise
stories.subtitle: A whole new horizon.
stories.label: From the archives / Our 13th anniversary
stories.imageAlt: Vision of the Seas sailing between cliffs
stories.summary: Our 13th anniversary, our first cruise, and the journey that started it all.
stories.context: This story remembers our 13th anniversary and our very first cruise. We’ve since celebrated our 20th anniversary and taken at least ten more cruises. We’re keeping this opening chapter just as we remember it.
